capabilities: Capture links, shared text, direct notes, images, and local attachments as Raw cards
Extract readable text from .pdf, .md, and .markdown files
Generate titles, previews, categories, and recommendation scores with a configured AI provider
Resolve GitHub repositories and preserve their README Markdown
Distill approved cards into a linked Wiki after explicit approval
disambiguation: Not a read-it-later service or web clipper alone; captured cards must pass an explicit review step before anything is written to the Wiki.
extras: Manifest carries the standard notice that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Scanned PDFs without a text layer require external OCR before capture. The full user guide lives in docs/user-guide.md rather than the README. The bundled selfgrow-wiki agent skill keeps Wiki writes behind a proposal-and-approval step. Includes an extensive privacy and network disclosure section; all data stays in the vault and there is no account or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in pipeline for capturing external material into a review queue and deciding later which of it becomes permanent notes.

relations.evidence: AI providers: OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
GitHub: GitHub API, repository pages, and raw content hosts are used to resolve repositories
TikHub or a custom extraction endpoint is used only after the user enables it

requires.name: OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, or custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint

summary: Capture-first tool that saves links, text, images, PDFs, Markdown files, and GitHub repos as reviewable cards, then distills selected ones into a linked Wiki.
